seo.title: Why Odoo for Your Company | AIODYX
seo.description: What Odoo is in plain words, the problems it solves, Community vs Enterprise, and when Odoo is not the right choice for you.

intro.title: Why Odoo
intro.body: A plain explanation for business owners. No technical background needed.

whatIs.title: What Odoo is
body: Odoo is business software made by Odoo S.A., a company based in Belgium. Companies around the world use it to run sales, stock, purchasing, accounting, HR and more.

It's what people call an ERP system. That means one system where every department works on the same data. When sales issues an invoice, accounting sees it. When the warehouse ships an order, stock goes down. Nobody types the same thing twice.
Odoo comes as separate apps that fit together. You pick the ones you need and add more later.

items.title: Excel sheets everywhere
items.body: Every department keeps its own file. Versions get mixed up, formulas break, and when someone leaves, their file leaves with them. In Odoo, everyone works on the same records, and you can see who changed what.

items.title: Programs that don't talk to each other
items.body: The accounting program doesn't know what the warehouse shipped. The POS doesn't know what purchasing ordered. So someone copies numbers between them by hand, and mistakes creep in. In Odoo, one action updates every app that needs it.

items.title: No clear numbers
items.body: Ask how much stock you have, who owes you money, or which product actually makes a profit, and the answer is 'give me a day'. Odoo shows these answers on screen, from live data.

items.title: Everything depends on a few people
items.body: When only one person knows how invoicing works or where the price list is, work stops when they're off. In Odoo, the steps live in the system, so new staff learn faster.

items.title: Fewer manual steps
items.body: A confirmed sale can create the delivery, the invoice and the stock update. Your team stops doing the same work twice.

items.title: Decisions on today's numbers
items.body: Dashboards and reports show sales, cash, stock and overdue payments as they are now.

items.title: Control over who sees what
items.body: Each user sees only their part of the business. You can require approval for purchases above a set amount.

items.title: Room to grow
items.body: Add users, branches, companies or apps as you grow. You keep the same system and the same data.

items.title: Local rules covered
items.body: Odoo has ready setups for Saudi and Jordanian accounting, with local taxes and e-invoicing.

editions.title: Community or Enterprise?
editions.body: Odoo comes in two editions. Both share the same base, and you can move from Community to Enterprise later.

community.name: Community
community.body: The free, open-source edition. There's no license fee, but you still pay for setup, hosting and support.
points: No per-user fee
Covers sales, CRM, purchasing, inventory, manufacturing, invoicing, POS, website, projects and basic HR
Runs on your own server or a cloud server you rent
Some apps are missing, like full accounting reports, payroll and Studio

enterprise.name: Enterprise
enterprise.body: The paid edition. You pay a subscription per user, and you get more apps and more features inside each app.
points: Full accounting with financial reports and bank reconciliation
Payroll, Studio, Barcode, Quality and other extra apps
Can run on Odoo's cloud, on Odoo.sh, or on your own server
Version upgrades included in the subscription

editions.note: The right edition depends on the apps you need and how many people will use the system. We compare both for your case in the consultation.

items.title: Odoo Online
items.body: Odoo hosts it for you. It's quick to start and there's no server to manage. Enterprise only, and it doesn't allow custom code, so it suits companies that use standard features.

items.title: Odoo.sh
items.body: Odoo's cloud platform for companies that need custom development. Enterprise only.

items.title: Your own server
items.body: In your office or on a cloud server you rent. Works with Community or Enterprise. You control everything, and someone has to look after the server.

notFit.title: When Odoo is not the right fit
notFit.body: Odoo fits a lot of companies. Not all of them. We'd rather tell you now than after you've paid.

items.title: You only need simple invoicing
items.body: If you're a small team with a few invoices a month and no stock, a simple accounting program may be enough.

items.title: Nobody on your side can own the project
items.body: Odoo needs someone in your company who makes decisions and gets the team to use it. Without that person, the project stalls.

items.title: Every old habit must stay the same
items.body: Odoo works best when you adjust some steps to its way of working. If every process has to stay exactly as it is, customization costs grow fast.

items.title: Your sector runs on specialized software
items.body: Hospitals, banks and insurance companies usually rely on systems built for their field. Odoo can work next to that software, but it may not replace it.

notFit.closing: If one of these sounds like you, tell us in the consultation. We'll say it straight, even if the answer is that you don't need Odoo.

cta.body: Book a free consultation. We'll look at how you work today and tell you if Odoo makes sense.

seo.title: Odoo FAQ: Cost, Timeline, Arabic, ZATCA | AIODYX
seo.description: Straight answers about Odoo: cost, timeline, data migration, Arabic, mobile, hosting, licenses, e-invoicing and support after go-live.

intro.title: Questions about Odoo
intro.body: Short, honest answers to what business owners ask before they start.

items.q: What is Odoo?
items.a: Odoo is business software that runs sales, stock, purchasing, accounting, HR and more in one system. It's made by Odoo S.A. in Belgium and comes as separate apps that share the same data. Companies start with the apps they need and add more later.

items.q: What does ERP mean?
items.a: ERP stands for Enterprise Resource Planning. In plain words, it's one system for the whole company, so sales, the warehouse, accounting and HR work on the same data instead of separate files and programs. Odoo is an ERP system.

items.q: How much does an Odoo implementation cost?
items.a: The cost of an Odoo project depends on the number of apps and users, whether you choose Community or Enterprise, how much customization you need, and how much data has to move. Enterprise also has a yearly or monthly subscription paid to Odoo, and hosting has its own cost. AIODYX gives you a written estimate after a free consultation and a study of your needs.

items.q: How long does it take to implement Odoo?
items.a: It depends on the number of apps, the amount of data and how much customization is needed. A small company using standard Odoo apps usually goes live within a few weeks. Larger projects with manufacturing, many branches or heavy customization can take several months.

items.q: Can I keep my data from Excel or my old system?
items.a: Yes. Customers, suppliers, products, opening balances, open invoices and stock quantities can be moved into Odoo from Excel or from most other systems. AIODYX cleans and checks the data with you before go-live. Older transaction history can be imported or kept in the old system, depending on how much you need it.

items.q: Does Odoo work in Arabic?
items.a: Yes. Odoo has a full Arabic interface that reads right to left, and each user can choose Arabic or English. Invoices and other documents can be printed in the customer's language.

items.q: Can I use Odoo on my phone?
items.a: Yes. Odoo works in any phone or tablet browser, and there are Odoo apps for iPhone and Android. Salespeople, managers and employees can check data, approve requests and log hours from their phones.

items.q: Should we host Odoo in the cloud or on our own server?
items.a: Both work. Odoo Online is hosted by Odoo and is the simplest option, but it doesn't allow custom code. Odoo.sh is Odoo's cloud for companies that need custom development. Your own server gives you full control, but someone has to maintain it. AIODYX helps you choose based on your needs and budget.

items.q: How do Odoo user licenses work?
items.a: Odoo Community is free and has no user fees. Odoo Enterprise is a subscription paid per user, and the price depends on the plan and the number of users. Customers and suppliers who only use the Odoo online portal don't need a paid user.

items.q: Which is better for us, Odoo Community or Enterprise?
items.a: Odoo Community is free and covers sales, purchasing, inventory, invoicing, POS, manufacturing and projects. Odoo Enterprise adds full accounting, payroll, Studio and other apps, plus version upgrades. The right choice depends on the apps you need and your budget, and AIODYX compares both for your case.

items.q: Do we have to use all of Odoo's apps?
items.a: No. You can start with one or two Odoo apps, like Sales and Accounting, and add Inventory, HR or a website later. New apps connect to the data you already have, so you don't start over.

items.q: Does Odoo support ZATCA e-invoicing in Saudi Arabia?
items.a: Yes. Odoo's Saudi localization supports ZATCA e-invoicing, including phase 2, the integration phase with the Fatoora platform. AIODYX sets up the connection, runs the compliance checks with ZATCA, and tests your invoices before you switch it on.

items.q: Does Odoo work with JoFotara in Jordan?
items.a: Yes. Odoo has a Jordan e-invoicing module that sends invoices to JoFotara, Jordan's national e-invoicing system. It needs a recent Odoo version. AIODYX sets it up with your JoFotara access details and tests it before you start issuing invoices through it.

items.q: What support do we get after go-live?
items.a: AIODYX stays with you after go-live for questions, fixes, small changes and Odoo version upgrades. The first weeks after launch get closer attention, because that's when most questions come up. The support plan is agreed with you based on your size and needs.

items.q: Can Odoo be customized?
items.a: Yes. Odoo can be changed with new fields, reports, printed layouts, workflows and connections to other systems. AIODYX uses standard Odoo features first and customizes only what you really need, because every custom change adds cost and work at upgrade time.

items.q: Will my team be able to use Odoo?
items.a: Yes, with the right training. AIODYX trains each team on the Odoo screens it actually uses, with your own data, in Arabic or English. We also train key users in your company who can help colleagues after go-live.

items.q: Can Odoo handle more than one branch or company?
items.a: Yes. Odoo can run several companies, branches and warehouses in one system, each with its own accounts if needed, and in more than one currency. Owners can look at each one separately or at all of them together.

items.q: Is our data safe in Odoo?
items.a: On Odoo Online and Odoo.sh, Odoo hosts your data and takes care of backups. On your own server, backups and security are your responsibility or your partner's. In every setup, each Odoo user sees only what their access rights allow.

items.q: What happens in the free consultation?

apps.name: Accounting & Invoicing

seo.title: Odoo Accounting and Invoicing | AIODYX
seo.description: Invoices, bills, payments, tax and financial reports in Odoo, set up for Jordan and Saudi Arabia. See what changes for your finance team.

apps.promise: Know where your money stands every day, not at month-end.
apps.for: Finance managers, accountants, and owners who want to see cash, receivables and profit without waiting for month-end.
features: Issue customer invoices and record supplier bills.
Record payments and match them to invoices, so you always know who still owes you.
Import bank statements and reconcile them with your entries.
Send payment reminders to customers with overdue invoices.
Track costs by branch, project or department with cost centers.
Work in more than one currency. Odoo records exchange differences for you.
Get tax reports, profit and loss, balance sheet and aged receivables from live data.
apps.outcome: Month-end stops being a week of chasing numbers. Sales and purchases reach the books when they happen, so closing is mostly checking. Open the system any morning and you see your cash, what customers owe you, and what you owe suppliers.
apps.connects: Customer invoices come straight from confirmed sales and POS sessions. Supplier bills come from purchase orders. Stock movements can post their value to accounting, and payroll posts salary entries. Every other app ends up here.

faq.q: Does Odoo Accounting follow Saudi and Jordanian tax rules?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo has local setups for both countries, with a chart of accounts and taxes ready to use. We review them with your accountant and adjust them to your company.

faq.q: Can our external accountant or auditor still work with us?
faq.a: Yes. They can get their own user in Odoo, or receive the reports they need exported to Excel or PDF.

faq.q: Is full accounting available in the free Community edition?
faq.a: Community covers invoicing and payments. Full accounting, with financial reports, bank reconciliation tools and fixed assets, is part of Enterprise.

faq.q: Can we start in the middle of the year?
faq.a: Yes. We bring in your opening balances and open invoices on the start date, so your books continue from where they were.

apps.name: Sales & CRM

seo.title: Odoo Sales and CRM | AIODYX
seo.description: Track every lead, send clear quotes and follow each deal until it's invoiced. See how Odoo Sales and CRM work for your sales team.

apps.promise: Follow every deal from the first call to the paid invoice.
apps.for: Sales managers and sales teams who handle quotes, follow-ups and customer accounts, and owners who want to know what's coming in.
features: See all open deals on one board, by stage, from new lead to won.
Capture leads from your website forms and emails without typing them in.
Schedule calls and follow-ups, so no customer waits because someone forgot.
Build quotes from your product list with the right prices and discounts for each customer.
Send quotes by email. Customers can accept and sign online.
Turn an accepted quote into an order, a delivery and an invoice.
See sales by salesperson, product or period, and why deals were lost.
apps.outcome: Customer history stops living in people's phones. When a salesperson is away, someone else opens the deal and sees every call, email and quote. Managers see the real pipeline instead of asking around.
apps.connects: A confirmed order tells the warehouse what to ship and tells accounting what to invoice. If stock is short, it can trigger a purchase or a manufacturing order. Website forms send new leads straight into CRM.

faq.q: Can each salesperson see only their own customers?
faq.a: Yes. You can set access so salespeople see their own deals, while managers see the whole team.

faq.q: Can different customers get different prices?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo uses price lists, so wholesale customers, retail customers or a specific account can each get their own prices and discounts.

faq.q: Can our sales team use it from their phones?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo works in the phone browser, and there are Odoo apps for iPhone and Android, so they can update a deal right after a meeting.

apps.name: Inventory & Warehouse

seo.title: Odoo Inventory and Warehouse | AIODYX
seo.description: Know what's in stock, where it is and what it's worth. Odoo Inventory for shops, distributors and factories in Jordan and Saudi Arabia.

apps.promise: Know what's in stock and where, at any moment.
apps.for: Warehouse managers, storekeepers, and owners who are tired of counts that never match the system.
features: See stock per warehouse and per location, updated with every receipt, sale and transfer.
Receive goods against purchase orders and check what arrived against what you ordered.
Pick, pack and ship orders in one step or several, depending on how your warehouse works.
Track batch numbers, serial numbers and expiry dates where you need them.
Set minimum stock levels, so Odoo prepares purchase orders when stock runs low.
Add shipping and customs to product cost, so your margins are real.
Run stock counts and fix differences, with a record of every adjustment.
apps.outcome: Stock in the system matches stock on the shelf, so sales can promise delivery dates they can keep. You stop over-ordering slow items and running out of fast ones. Stock value shows up in accounting without a separate calculation.
apps.connects: Sales orders create deliveries. Purchase orders create receipts. Manufacturing takes components out and puts finished goods in. The POS and the online store sell from the same stock, and each movement can update stock value in accounting.

faq.q: Can we manage more than one warehouse or branch?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo handles several warehouses and locations, and you move stock between them with transfers.

faq.q: Does it work with barcode scanners?
faq.a: Yes. You can scan barcodes in many screens. The dedicated Barcode app, for receiving and picking with a scanner or phone, is part of Enterprise.

faq.q: Can it handle products with expiry dates?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo tracks batches and expiry dates, and can alert you before products expire.

faq.q: How do we get our current stock into Odoo?
faq.a: We import your product list and opening quantities from Excel or your old system. A full stock count before go-live makes sure the starting numbers are right.

apps.name: Purchase

seo.title: Odoo Purchase Management | AIODYX
seo.description: Request quotes, compare vendors, approve orders and check bills against what arrived. See how Odoo Purchase works day to day.

apps.promise: Order on time, and pay only for what arrived.
apps.for: Purchasing officers, procurement managers, and owners who approve spending.
features: Send requests for quotation to vendors and turn the best one into a purchase order.
Compare offers from several vendors for the same items.
Keep each vendor's prices and delivery times on the product.
Require a manager's approval for orders above an amount you choose.
Get purchase suggestions when stock drops below its minimum.
Follow late deliveries and remind vendors.
Check vendor bills against what you ordered and what actually arrived before you pay.
apps.outcome: Purchasing stops depending on memory and WhatsApp messages. Every order has a record, an approval and a status. Finance pays bills knowing the goods arrived.
apps.connects: Low stock in Inventory creates purchase suggestions. Received goods go into stock. Vendor bills go to Accounting, matched to the order. In Manufacturing, missing components can trigger a purchase.

faq.q: Can we set approval limits?
faq.a: Yes. You can require a manager's approval for purchase orders above a set amount.

faq.q: Can we buy in foreign currencies?
faq.a: Yes. Purchase orders and vendor bills can be in any currency, and Accounting converts them using exchange rates.

faq.q: Can we include customs and shipping in product cost?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo can add landed costs, like freight and customs, to the cost of the products in a shipment.

apps.name: Manufacturing

seo.title: Odoo Manufacturing (MRP) | AIODYX
seo.description: Plan production, track materials and know the real cost of every product. Odoo Manufacturing for factories in Jordan and Saudi Arabia.

apps.promise: Plan production and know what each product really costs.
apps.for: Factory owners, production managers and planners who need to see what to make, what's missing and what it costs.
features: Define a bill of materials for each product, meaning its components and quantities.
Create manufacturing orders from sales orders or from minimum stock levels.
Check that components are available before you start, and order what's missing.
Plan work across machines and production lines, with the time each step takes.
Record what was used, what was produced and what was scrapped.
Send part of the work to subcontractors and track the materials you sent them.
See the actual cost of each production run, including materials, labor and machine time.
apps.outcome: Production stops running on paper and phone calls. Planners know which orders can start today and which are waiting for materials. Owners see the real cost per unit, so prices come from numbers instead of estimates.
apps.connects: Sales orders can trigger production. Manufacturing pulls components from Inventory and adds finished products back. Missing components can trigger Purchase, and production costs flow into Accounting.

faq.q: Does Odoo work for small workshops, or only big factories?
faq.a: Both. A small workshop can start with simple bills of materials and manufacturing orders, then add work centers and planning later.

faq.q: Can it handle quality checks?
faq.a: Yes, through the Quality app, which is part of Enterprise. You set checks at specific steps and record the results.

faq.q: Can we trace batches from raw material to finished product?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo tracks lots and serial numbers through production, so you can see which batch of material went into which product.

apps.name: HR, Payroll & Attendance

seo.title: Odoo HR, Payroll and Attendance | AIODYX
seo.description: Employee files, leave requests, attendance and payroll in one place. See how Odoo HR works for companies in Jordan and Saudi Arabia.

apps.promise: Staff files, leave and salaries in one place, without the paperwork.
apps.for: HR managers, office managers, and owners who handle employee records, leave and monthly salaries.
features: Keep each employee's file, contract and documents in one record.
Let employees request leave from their phone, and managers approve it.
See everyone's leave balance without a separate sheet.
Record attendance on a kiosk screen, from the browser or from the phone.
Calculate salaries with your allowances, deductions and overtime.
Let employees submit expenses with a photo of the receipt.
Post payroll and expenses to accounting without typing them again.
apps.outcome: HR stops chasing paper forms and leave balances. Employees get answers without asking HR. Payroll is based on real attendance and approved leave, and it reaches accounting on its own.
apps.connects: Approved leave and attendance feed into Payroll. Salaries and expense claims post to Accounting. Timesheets from Project show where staff time went.

faq.q: Is Payroll included in the free Community edition?
faq.a: No. Payroll is part of Odoo Enterprise. Employees, Time Off, Attendance and Expenses are available in both editions.

faq.q: Can Odoo follow our local payroll rules?
faq.a: We set up your salary structure, allowances and deductions during implementation, including local items like social insurance. Then we compare the results with your current payroll before go-live.

faq.q: Can it connect to our fingerprint devices?
faq.a: Often yes, depending on the device. It usually needs an extra connector. We check your device model during the study and tell you what's possible.

apps.name: Point of Sale

seo.title: Odoo Point of Sale (POS) | AIODYX
seo.description: Sell in shops and restaurants with Odoo POS, with stock and accounting updated as you sell. Works on tablets and PCs.

apps.promise: Sell fast at the counter, with stock updated after every sale.
apps.for: Shops, showrooms, cafés and restaurants, with one branch or many.
features: Sell from a tablet, PC or touch screen, with barcode scanners and receipt printers.
Accept cash and card, and split one payment between them.
Run discounts, loyalty points, coupons and gift cards.
Open and close each cashier's session with a cash count, so differences show up the same day.
Look up customers and their purchase history at the counter.
Keep selling for a while if the internet drops. Sales sync when it's back.
See sales per branch, cashier and product as they happen.
apps.outcome: Every sale reduces stock in the system right away. Cash differences get caught at the end of each shift, not at the end of the month. Owners see each branch's sales from anywhere.
apps.connects: The POS sells from the same stock as the warehouse and the online store. Each closed session posts to Accounting. Loyalty programs and gift cards can work across your branches.

faq.q: What hardware do we need?
faq.a: A tablet or PC, plus a receipt printer, cash drawer and barcode scanner if you use them. We check your current devices during the study, since some may work as they are.

faq.q: Does it work for restaurants?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo POS has a restaurant mode with table plans, split bills and orders sent to the kitchen.

faq.q: Can we run many branches?
faq.a: Yes. Each branch gets its own POS and stock location, and you see all branches together in one system.

apps.name: Website & eCommerce

seo.title: Odoo Website and Online Store | AIODYX
seo.description: Build your website and online store on Odoo, with products, stock and orders in the same system as your shop and warehouse.

apps.promise: An online store connected to your stock and your books.
apps.for: Shops, distributors and brands that want to sell online, and companies that need a website without a separate system.
features: Build pages with a drag-and-drop editor, in Arabic and English.
Publish products from your catalog with photos, variants and prices.
Show real stock, so customers don't order what you don't have.
Take online payments through providers that work in your country.
Let customers log in to reorder, track orders and download invoices.
Show business customers their own prices when they log in.
Turn contact form messages into leads in CRM.
apps.outcome: Online orders land in the same place as phone and shop orders. The warehouse ships them like any other order. You don't keep a second product list or copy orders between systems.
apps.connects: Products, prices and stock come from Sales and Inventory. Online orders go to the warehouse for delivery and to Accounting for invoicing. Contact forms feed CRM.

faq.q: Can we use our own domain name?
faq.a: Yes. Your Odoo website can run on your own domain.

faq.q: Which payment methods can customers use?
faq.a: Odoo works with several online payment providers. Which ones you can use depends on your country and your bank, so we check this with you during the study.

faq.q: We already have a website. Do we have to replace it?
faq.a: No. You can keep your current website and use Odoo for the rest. Connecting an outside online store to Odoo is possible, but it needs extra development.

apps.name: Project & Timesheets

seo.title: Odoo Project and Timesheets | AIODYX
seo.description: Plan tasks, track hours and bill clients for the time spent. See how Odoo Project helps service firms and contractors.

apps.promise: See where your team's time goes, and bill for it.
apps.for: Consulting firms, agencies, contractors, and any team that runs projects for clients.
features: Split each project into tasks with owners, deadlines and stages.
Log hours on each task from the browser or the phone.
Bill clients by hours worked, by fixed price or by milestone.
Let clients follow their project's tasks through a portal.
Compare hours and costs with what you planned and what you billed.
Set recurring tasks for routine work.
apps.outcome: You stop guessing which projects make money. Hours get logged where the work happens, so invoices match the work done. Managers see each person's workload before deadlines slip.
apps.connects: A sold service can create a project on its own. Timesheets feed invoices in Accounting. Purchases and expenses can be linked to a project, so you see its real cost.

faq.q: Can clients see their project?
faq.a: Yes. Clients can get portal access to see tasks and progress and leave comments, without access to the rest of your system.

faq.q: Does it have Gantt charts?
faq.a: Yes, in Odoo Enterprise. Community shows projects as lists, boards and calendars.

faq.q: Can we invoice clients from timesheets?
faq.a: Yes. Approved hours can go straight onto the client's invoice, at the rate you set for the service.

Customers go over their credit, and nobody notices until it's late.
Orders get picked wrong or shipped late because the warehouse works from paper.
Collections depend on someone remembering to call.
You don't know your real margin after freight and customs.

The warehouse gets a picking list and ships the order. Stock updates as it leaves.
The invoice is created from what was actually delivered.
Finance sees which invoices are overdue and sends reminders from the system.
An import shipment arrives. Freight and customs get added to the product cost, so your margins stay accurate.

faq.q: Can we set a credit limit per customer?
faq.a: Yes. Odoo can warn your team when a new order takes a customer over their credit limit.

faq.q: Can our sales reps take orders on the road?

faq.q: Can customers place orders online?
faq.a: Yes. With Odoo eCommerce, business customers log in, see their own prices and reorder without calling.

Raw material stock is always off.
Tracing a faulty batch back to its materials takes days.
industries.appsNote: Manufacturing for bills of materials and production orders, Inventory for raw materials and finished goods, Purchase for components, Sales for customer orders and Accounting for costing.

Missing components already have purchase orders, created from minimum stock rules.
Operators record what they used and what they produced on each order.
Finished goods go into stock, and sales can confirm delivery dates.
The manager compares today's actual production cost with the planned cost.

faq.a: Yes. Production can start from a customer order or from minimum stock levels, and you can mix both.

faq.a: Machine time is tracked through work centers. Odoo also has a Maintenance app for planning and recording machine maintenance.

faq.a: It depends on how many products, steps and production lines you have. Manufacturing projects usually take longer than retail or sales projects, because bills of materials and costing need careful setup and testing.

industries.name: Services & consulting firms

Proposals, contracts and invoices live in different places.

Consultants log hours on their tasks during the day.
The project manager sees hours used against hours sold.
At month-end, approved hours go onto the client's invoice.
Before your next pricing decision, you check profit by client and by project.

faq.a: Yes. You can invoice fixed monthly fees. Odoo's Subscriptions app, part of Enterprise, can create those invoices on schedule.

faq.q: Can different staff have different billing rates?
faq.a: Yes. You can set rates per service or per employee on each project.

faq.q: Can we track expenses per client?
faq.a: Yes. Staff can log expenses against a project, and you can re-invoice them to the client.

industries.name: Contracting & construction

seo.title: Odoo for Contracting and Construction | AIODYX

Site teams and the office work from different numbers.

Labor hours and subcontractor bills are charged to the same project.

faq.q: Can we track budget against actual cost?
faq.a: Yes. Each project gets its own cost center, so purchases, labor and subcontractor bills add up against it, and you can set a budget for it in Odoo Accounting.

faq.q: Can we bill clients by progress?

pains: Orders get lost between the waiter and the kitchen.

Guests split the bill and pay by cash or card.

At closing, each cashier counts the drawer, and you see sales per branch and per dish.

faq.q: Can we track food cost per dish?
faq.a: Yes. You set a recipe for each dish with its ingredients. Odoo deducts the ingredients as dishes sell and shows the cost per dish.

faq.q: Does it support QR menus and self-ordering?
faq.a: Odoo has a self-order feature where guests scan a QR code at the table to see the menu and order. We check with you whether it suits your service.
